page.title: Retro ledger
page.subtitle: Retrospectives on how the spec → plan → implement → review → verify pipeline performed — the process itself, not the code it produced.

empty.noFileBody: Nothing has been written to {path}. The ledger records how the SDD pipeline performed — where a spec was thin, where a plan missed a step, which review findings were real. It is written by the /retro slash command, which runs only when a human types it; nothing in DevDigest starts one.
empty.noEntriesBody: The ledger exists but has no entries. Each entry opens by checking whether the previous entry's proposals were applied and whether they helped. Entries are added by the /retro slash command, which runs only when a human types it — nothing in DevDigest starts one, and this page never writes to the file.

scope.title: What does not go here
scope.body: Findings about the codebase — gotchas, conventions, library quirks — belong in a package's INSIGHTS.md, not in this ledger. A finding in the wrong home is lost to the reader who needs it.
